description: Write the texts of the excellence roadmap in one more language. One grid, several languages: a group keeps one roadmap and its translations, and every site is assessed on the same items, each reading them in its own language. A translation is part of the standard, so it is the work of whoever owns the grid: writing one requires an organization admin (an API token created by an admin with the admin permission; a claude.ai connector acts as an editor at most and is refused with 403). Read what is stored first with get_roadmap_translation. A field given replaces the stored translation, an empty string removes it (the source language is served again), a theme or item left out keeps what it had; at least one text is required. Translate the meaning of each level faithfully: a description that drifts changes what the site is scored on. The source language is not written here; the grid is edited in the app.

levels.description: The levels, in the order of the roadmap (first = level 1)

locale.description: The language to write; never the source language of the roadmap

name.description: Name of the roadmap in that language

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

themes.description: Themes to translate, by id; those left out keep their translation

level_descriptions.description: One per level, in order; an empty string leaves that level in the source language

name: translate_roadmap
title: Write a roadmap translation
